_comment: Evaluation corpus for tool search. Tools mirror the shape of real MCP
servers (names and one-line descriptions of the kind those servers ship).
METHODOLOGY, and the thing that makes this worth anything: queries are
written in the vocabulary a USER or AGENT would use, NOT by copying words
out of the tool they are supposed to find. A query built from the target's
own description measures nothing except that substring matching works.
lexical  - shares real vocabulary with the target; a good lexical
scorer should find it, and failure here is a genuine bug.
semantic - needs synonym or world knowledge ('bug report' -> issue,
'save this' -> memory_store). Largely out of reach for any
lexical scorer; tracked separately so it is never mistaken
for lexical headroom, and so we can see what embeddings
`expect` lists every answer a reasonable person would accept.
